title: Handovers
subtitle: Pass one staff member's areas and customers to another. Until the receiver accepts in the app, the original staff member stays responsible.

empty.pendingBody: Create a handover here when someone goes on leave or changes area.

pendingHint: {{name}} stays responsible until the receiver accepts in the app. It expires if not accepted within 72 hours.
cashWarning: Cash on hand is not transferred by a handover. The outgoing staff member must deposit it.
cancelDesc: The handover of {{n}} customers from {{from}} to {{to}} will be cancelled. The customers stay with {{from}}.

form.title: New handover
form.desc: The receiver gets a notification in the app and accepts or rejects.
form.areasPickFrom: Pick the staff member first; their areas appear here.
form.areasNone: This staff member holds no areas.
form.temporaryHelp: When on, customers return to the original staff member automatically on the end date.
form.endHelp: Responsibility returns automatically after this date.

errors.same: Cannot hand over to the same person
errors.past: Use today or a later date
errors.endBefore: End date must be after the effective date
errors.reason: Write a reason of at least {{min}} characters
